security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' data: asset: http://asset.localhost; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: A folder that is the same on your computer and your phone
bundle.longDescription: OwlTransfer keeps one folder identical on your desktop and your Android phone over your own Wi-Fi, with no account and no server. Both devices keep a full copy, so either works offline.
